author: Dr Ben Miles
description:
Scientists have discovered that the bacterium Ewingella americana, isolated from Japanese tree frogs, can eradicate tumors in mice with a single intravenous dose. This bacterium selectively proliferates in low-oxygen tumor environments and activates immune responses, outperforming some current cancer treatments.

Source Article: https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/full/10.1080/19490976.2025.2599562
